chapter_theme: The last four stanzas of Pambatti's song continue the formula 'we will shut the snake in the pot': the body-pot is named in turn by nail, thread and the letter ma, and through it the snake climbs the pillar and the ladder, the breath weaves its cloth, the body is put to the crucible, and the practitioner, having offered mind, speech, body and the five senses, stands as the letter si, Siva.
structure_note: Four எண்சீர் விருத்தம் stanzas (2105 to 2108), each opening with a different pot and ending in ஆடாய் பாம்பே, except 2107, which ends in a warning to keep the secret. 2106 drops the snake for a weaving cipher. All four are cipher throughout.

2105.reading: We will shut the snake in the nailed pot, climb the fort of fire and look, set it dancing on the ruby pillar, feed it mind, speech and body as prey, cut even the rope of shame, stand seeking the feet of the Lord in whom there is no Death, find the way up the ladder and climb: no one knows this.
2105.nuance: The fort of fire and the ruby pillar read as the heat at the base and the central channel (compare the golden pillar of 2063 and the pillar of Om of 2095); the ladder is the ascent through the centres. மனம் வாக்குக் காயம், the three instruments, are themselves fed to the snake. நாணிக் கயிறு is the rope of shame, and நாண் is also a bowstring.

2106.reading: We will spin the thread north and east, set the warp in the whirl, roll the ball of yarn on the path that is walked, weave the cloth on the path that is not walked, throw the shuttle on the western bank and sell what we gathered everywhere; we can also gather it in and keep it within the One: we have seen the primal foot.
2106.nuance: The loom is a cipher with no key in the text. Tradition would take the thread as the breath, the whirl (சுழல்) as the sushumna, the walked and unwalked paths as the side channels and the central one, and the cloth as the body or the work done in it. The last line turns the trade outward and then back: what is spread everywhere can also be held in the One.

2107.reading: We will shut the snake in the pot of strings and take our pleasure within the sushumna; we will beg alms with a bowl; we have crossed the steps of ten, eight and three; we will put the filthy body to the crucible; as the knowing one gives us firm assurance, thinking that the truth of this word will bear fruit, see and speak: careful, careful.
2107.nuance: சூத்திரம் is a string or mechanism (the puppet's string of 2047) and also a formula. புடம் is the alchemist's calcining fire: the body itself is to be refined, as in karpa practice. பத்தெட்டு மூன்று is a count tradition might fit to tattvas or centres; the text does not say. பதனம் பதனம், take care, closes the song by guarding the secret.

2108.reading: We will shut the snake in the pot of ம, we have scooped up and eaten the breath of the jewelled circle, we will push away the pots of வ, leap past the crooked dream, let it dance in the open sea of space, offer the five instruments as sacrifice, and saying we stand become the form of சி, see the holy feet, be clear and dance.
2108.nuance: The letters are those of the five-letter mantra: in the usual Saiva reading ம stands for mala or the body, வ for grace, சி for Siva. The snake begins in ம and ends as சி, so the stanza is a passage through நமசிவாய from bond to Siva. பஞ்ச கருவி are the five senses, and வாசி is the breath as practice.

links.note: Bathiragiriyar asks when the letters va and ma will become the sword and he will stand contained in the letter a with si; Pambatti shuts the snake in the pot of ma, pushes away the pots of va and becomes the form of si. Both make the syllables of the five-letter mantra places one passes through.

The golden pillar in the middle street of 2063 returns as the ruby pillar on which the snake is set dancing, now with a fort of fire below and a ladder up. The same central pillar, given its place in the ascent.

source_issues: 2107: பத்தெட்டு மூன்று படி has no evident key, and the closing line (பார்த்துரை யிதன்மெய் பலிக்க வெண்ணி) is loosely constructed.
